sourceFile: Ground Floor - GF01 Cabin Approved Layout P01.FCStd
notes: BlenderContext contains the exact latest native architecture context, including open/cropped faces; inherited Z0 CAD references are separately retained and shown grey in the preview. Model-derived context may include immediately adjoining doorway/floor pieces. No source offsets are silently reconciled.

Includes selected four-person cabin A, four full-size tables/chairs and recessed outward door. Cupboard allowance is already factored; do not deduct it again. Occupied centre gap is about 3 ft 1 in, reducing to about 1 ft 1 in during simultaneous pullback; operator retreat and existing-door/hardware clearances remain unresolved.
